module purpose: neorv32_twi holds a bus-written control register (enable, SCL prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretching enable), queues bus-written command words in a TX FIFO sub-unit, and runs a state machine that executes each command as a start sequence, a stop sequence or a 9-bit shift on twi_sda_o/twi_scl_o paced by a divided tick and a 4-phase sequence, sampling twi_sda_i/twi_scl_i; completed bytes go into an RX FIFO sub-unit read over the bus, status is returned on control reads, the enable is exported on clkgen_en_o and irq_o is raised when enabled, the TX FIFO is empty and the engine is idle.

use-case flows.value: control setting (enable, prescaler select, clock divider, clock-stretching enable) taken from bus_req_i.data on a write with addr(2)='0'
command word (data byte, ACK bit, 2-bit command code) enqueued into the TX FIFO on a bus write with addr(2)='1', then dequeued and accepted by the idle engine on a tick
SCL timing: prescaler-selected clkgen_i enable, divider count compared with ctrl.cdiv producing a tick, rotating phase state, phase strobes, and the clock-stretch halt that freezes phase rotation

bus engine: state 101 (SDA falls while SCL high), state 110 (SDA rises while SCL high), state 111 (9-bit shift: sreg(8) driven on SDA, sampled SDA shifted in, bit count, done), driving the line registers to twi_sda_o/twi_scl_o and sampling twi_sda_i/twi_scl_i
completed byte written into the RX FIFO on engine.done and returned on a bus data read (addr(2)='1'); control setting returned on a control read
status bits (sensed SCL/SDA, TX full, RX available, busy) on a control read; interrupt when enabled, TX FIFO empty and engine idle; enable exported to the clock generator

rstn_i clears control, interrupt, tick/counter, phase, engine and line registers (lines released high); a cleared enable flushes both FIFOs, stops the tick, forces the phase state to 0001 and clears engine.state(2)
